visualCharacteristics.purpose: Image-only 3-up gallery of equal rounded near-square tiles
visualCharacteristics.description: Image-only 3-up gallery of equal rounded near-square tiles (411x360) with no text per item, closed by a shared caption. cards-landscape is a 2-up grid of wide 16:10 tiles each carrying eyebrow, H3 and description; the item density, aspect and column count differ (<80%).

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: one cell with an image (optional caption cell)
contentPattern.description: Three look-alike images that flow in a grid: Cards (image-only items).

usage.description: Gallery ("Scenes from Amalfi") on the destinations template; the shared caption under the grid stays default content.

reuseGuidance: Use for photo-only grids. Items with titles or descriptions belong in cards-landscape.

cells: Eyebrow paragraph (place/country), H3 title, description paragraph, optional CTA link
withImages.notes: cards-landscape: image + H3 + description (no eyebrow on this page). cards-gallery: image cell only (text cell empty/omitted).

cells: Optional number or small icon, H3 title, description paragraph, optional arrow link
